en.headline: EuroCham says five-year plan gives firms clear strategic vision
en.dek: The European Chamber of Commerce in Hong Kong said the city’s first five-year plan will help foreign businesses understand long-term priorities and prepare products and solutions accordingly.
body: The European Chamber of Commerce in Hong Kong said the SAR’s inaugural five-year plan will give foreign firms a clearer picture of the city’s strategic direction over the next five years.

In an interview with RTHK, chamber chairman Johannes Hack said the public consultation document allows businesses to brainstorm ideas and plan ahead. He said companies particularly value knowing where Hong Kong wants to be in five years and what it will take to get there, enabling them to develop solutions that match those needs.

Hack noted European firms are especially interested in innovation and technology areas such as life sciences, biotech and sustainability linked to the Northern Metropolis. He suggested a lighthouse project, for example in medical equipment or medicine development, to demonstrate practical cooperation across the Greater Bay Area. He added that foreign companies already have a reasonably clear understanding of the Northern Metropolis through education programmes and site visits.

zh.headline: 歐洲商會：五年規劃助企業掌握長遠方向
zh.dek: 香港歐洲商會表示，本港首個五年規劃讓外資企業更清楚了解香港的長遠策略目標，有助提前部署產品及方案。
body: 香港歐洲商會表示，特區首個五年規劃將為外資企業提供更清晰的未來五年策略方向。
商會主席Johannes Hack接受香港電台訪問時表示，公開諮詢文件讓企業可以集思廣益及提前規劃。他指出，企業尤其希望了解香港五年後的目標及達成路徑，從而開發切合需要的方案。
Hack表示，歐洲企業對北都相關的創新科技範疇，例如生命科學、生物科技及可持續發展特別感興趣。他建議推出示範項目，例如醫療器材或藥物開發合作，展示大灣區實際協作成果。他亦指，透過教育活動及實地考察，外資企業對北都發展已有相當清晰的認識。
